title.zh: Crypto lobbies launch a last-minute TV campaign against banks to pass the CLARITY Act
title.en: Crypto lobbies launch a last-minute TV campaign against banks to pass the CLARITY Act

current_state.zh: Crypto industry groups launch a seven-figure TV ad campaign to push the CLARITY Act through a critical Senate cloture vote on Sept. 15, which would establish federal digital-asset market rules and split SEC/CFTC oversight.
current_state.en: Crypto industry groups launch a seven-figure TV ad campaign to push the CLARITY Act through a critical Senate cloture vote on Sept. 15, which would establish federal digital-asset market rules and split SEC/CFTC oversight.
